note: Nebraska National Forest (Bessey Ranger District) campground at Halsey, in the historic hand-planted Bessey forest. Loops of pine-shaded pads, most with electric; a group site and tent-only sites besides. Showers and flush restroom mid-May to mid-October; winter water only at the recreation building. The Middle Loup River (tubing, canoeing) and a 7-acre stocked pond are nearby, but the loops sit back in the trees, not on the water. ATVs may ride from the sites to the trailhead. --Claude
